fields.statement: Bug 'cmd/rhiza testscripts inherit RHIZA_*, SHIP_* and REX_*' does not reproduce on main: a probe script run from this run session (RHIZA_CHANGE, RHIZA_ACTOR, REX_SESSION... set) saw only RHIZA_TEST_* and GIT_CONFIG_*, because testscript starts from a fixed env and the in-process rhiza gets only scriptEnv's kept names (#605). The one host-env path left in the script path is daemon.NewReexec (internal/daemon/reexec.go) taking os.Environ()/os.Args, used by an in-process `rhiza daemon run`. How should this change set be scoped?
